quotes.text: Rachael s. 13 Jul 2026 The staff was very kind. They were experienced and very knowledgeable with the area. I went with a Groupon special. 25$ was very reasonable for a two hour boat ride. And the restaurant next door( Grille) is a place that you should not pass up also with reasonable pricesread moreread less

Seesters” birthday adventure!! It was a beautiful, magical sightseeing tour! We saw so many dolphins, pelicans, osprey, and they were very informative about the history of the location. It was wonderful and would recommend doing it again.!read moreread less

Beautiful River Tour It was a very relaxing, informative, and beautiful ride. I loved the Captain's commentary and stories about the area and Kelly making sure that we had the best views of the wildlife in the area. They did a great job!read moreread less

Highly recommend..will definitely do this again! Captain Bill and Tour guide Kelly were amazing! We were lucky, saw lots of dolphins! Our Granddaughter loved it! Lots of great local history and lagoon facts were shared!read moreread less
